text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report outlines the results of our investigation into installing speed humps on Valermo Drive, between Brown's Line and Rimilton Avenue. The results indicate that the criteria to justify installing speed humps are not satisfied.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Did NOT approve installing speed humps on Valermo Drive. 2. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Valermo Drive between Browns Line and Rimilton Avenue.
